name: multi-bot-adapter
description: Multi-channel chat bot adapters for QQ official Bot and WeChat wxclaw / iLink Bot: QR-code login, AppID/ClientSecret and bot token authentication, WebSocket gateway and long-polling intake, text and rich-media send/receive, voice reply, artifact delivery, admin commands, scheduled push, channel runtime, and protocol troubleshooting.

interface.shortDescription: QQ official Bot and WeChat wxclaw channel integration with QR login, media, voice, and troubleshooting
interface.longDescription: A complete adapter contract and two reference implementations for multi-channel chat bots. Covers QQ official Bot (WebSocket gateway, AccessToken refresh, passive reply msg_id, Markdown, file_info media upload, native voice) and WeChat wxclaw / iLink Bot (AuthorizationType headers, getupdates long polling, context_token, AES-ECB media upload and download, multi-account token backfill), plus shared channel runtime behavior: sessions, inbound files, artifacts, voice fallback, admin commands, scheduled push, and status reporting.
defaultPrompt: Integrate this messaging channel using the adapter contract and validate the protocol edge cases.
Debug why the wxclaw channel returns -14 or why QQ group replies are rejected.
